description: Address code review findings: multi-value ETag comparison, concurrent health probes with asyncio.gather, and X-XSS-Protection header consistency.
steps: Fix ETag comparison in content.py to handle multi-value If-None-Match headers (two places)
Add Cache-Control to 304 response headers in content.py (two places)
Change health probes in health.py from sequential to concurrent execution using asyncio.gather
Change X-XSS-Protection in _headers from '1; mode=block' to '0' for consistency with edge worker
acceptance_criteria: ETag comparison splits on commas and strips whitespace before matching
304 responses include both ETag and Cache-Control headers
Health probes run concurrently via asyncio.gather
X-XSS-Protection is consistently set to 0 across frontend _headers and edge worker
verification: Run: python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('app/api/v1/health.py').read()); ast.parse(open('app/api/v1/content.py').read()); print('OK')" from apps/backend
Run: npx vitest run from apps/edge
